initial_decision.brief_rationale: R217-2 establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity. Standardizing over the population distribution of Z identifies the causal risk difference: (100/250)(0.4−0.5) + (150/250)(0.9−0.6) = 0.14.
